CheckTitle: IAM Policies grant permissive role assumption
Description: Customer-Managed Policies (CMPs) have been observed granting AssumeRole on unrestricted (*) resources.
Risk: Overly permissive AssumeRole permissions expands the attack surface by enabling a principal to assume roles across multiple resources. This increases the potential impact of compromised credentials, and the risk of unauthorized access.

Recommendation.Text: Limit the scope of AssumeRole policies according to the principle of least privilege. Instead of wildcard (*) resources, specific the required role ARNs for the user according to their needs and requirements.
